attempts.why: Modal width 520px overflows 375px viewport causing horizontal clipping; max-width constrains it to viewport while preserving design on larger screens.

selfVerify.reason: Modal now fits viewport (343px width at x=16 → right edge 359px < 375px viewport, docScrollWidth=375px=no horizontal overflow) so 520px overflow clipping is gone. No other breakage: all other boxes within 375px (header 375px, cards 351px right edge, badge 358px), table horizontal scroll contained in .table-wrap (overflow:auto, doc not widened).
